subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork candidate, replace it with a narrow schema-only PR, or close it before queueing a new repair?
rationale: The issue is valid and the fix shape is small, but an open uneditable conflicting PR still claims the exact fix and must be resolved to avoid duplicate or unsafe cleanup work.

options.title: Replace with schema-only repair
options.body: Open a narrow maintainer-controlled repair that moves the field into `ToolExecBaseShape`, updates generated schema artifacts if still required, and leaves stale systemd changes behind.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Use the fork PR only if a maintainer can strip unrelated systemd changes and refresh it to a clean mergeable branch.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and remove unrelated drift.

recommendation.title: Replace with schema-only repair
recommendation.body: Open a narrow maintainer-controlled repair that moves the field into `ToolExecBaseShape`, updates generated schema artifacts if still required, and leaves stale systemd changes behind.
